title: Foreign Currency Transactions and Advance Consideration
summary: Addresses which exchange rate to use when translating advance consideration paid or received in a foreign currency, clarifying that the transaction date is the date of initial recognition of the prepayment or deferred income.

related.title: The Effects of Changes in Foreign Exchange Rates
related.relationship: The parent standard IFRIC 22 interprets, supplying the monetary/non-monetary distinction and general transaction-date translation rule

related.title: Revenue from Contracts with Customers
related.relationship: Governs recognition of the related revenue for advance consideration received from customers

related.title: Inventories
related.relationship: Governs recognition of inventory acquired using advance consideration

related.title: Property, Plant and Equipment
related.relationship: Governs recognition of PPE acquired using advance consideration
